method.name: ForceFirmwareUpgrade
method.tp:docstring: Issues a firmware upgrade on a connected Atrus device.

arg.name: firmware_path
arg.tp:docstring: Firmware Path (string): Path to the firmware file.

arg.name: success
arg.tp:docstring: Success (bool): Indicates whether the firmware upgrade succeeded or failed.

method.name: EnableDiagnostics
method.tp:docstring: Enables diagnostics for the current Atrus device.

arg.name: diag_interval
arg.tp:docstring: Diagnostics Interval (int): Delay between each diagnostic report (seconds)

arg.name: ext_diag_interval
arg.tp:docstring: Extended Diagnostics Interval (int): Delay between each extended diagnostic report (seconds)

method.name: DisableDiagnostics
method.tp:docstring: Disables diagnostics for the current Atrus device.
